title: Using Claims Data to Predict Pre-Operative BMI Among Bariatric Surgery Patients: Development of the BMI Before Bariatric Surgery Scoring System (B3S3)
summary: The B3S3 claims-data model estimated bariatric patients’ preoperative BMI against EHR measurements and was assessed on concurrent and later prospective-period holdouts. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
